title: The Late Witness
author: Hazel Brightwater
blurb: Beatrix Ashgrove, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
